As you currently experience hair loss, you know the condition isn’t fun and can cause you to lose some of your self-confidence. After all, your hair is a big part of who you are and can be a big sense of identity for some individuals.

With this being said, you may be searching high and low for hair loss products that can help combat your condition. However, the market is flooded with hair growth treatments for men and women suffering from hair loss, so it can often times be difficult to know which brand and products to buy.

In this article, we are going to focus solely on hims hair products vs Kiierr to help give you a better understanding of each company. Keep reading below to learn more!

Hims Hair Loss Details

Hims is a company designed strictly for males. There are a wide variety of products that they have to offer, but we are going to discuss all things hair. If you are a man suffering from hair loss, hims might be able to help you.

Before you get started, there is a process you will go through to get you connected with a physician who can help you choose the products right for you. First, you will create a profile with your information and background. You will then get connected with a physician who you will discuss your symptoms and medical history with. Next, the proper products will be sent to you with free delivery after properly prescribed by the physician. From here, you can start your treatment.

With your purchase of hims hair products, you will receive a 90-day money back guarantee if you do not see hair growth results.

Hims Hair Products

 There are several different hims hair loss products to choose from, depending on your hair loss situation and what you are looking for. Here are some of them:

1.) Hair Power Pack

The hims hair power pack comes with five different products to choose from. You will receive Finasteride and your choice of Minoxidil, biotin gummies, shampoo, and conditioner.

Monthly Cost: $23.00

2.) Non-Prescription Hair Kit

This kit contains Minoxidil, shampoo and vitamins. The goal of this kit is to stop further hair loss, grow new hair, and keep your existing hair healthy.

Monthly Cost: $30.00

3.) Edible Kit

This edible kit contains Finasteride and the biotin gummy vitamins.

Monthly Cost: $28.00

4.) Shampoo

Hims shampoo promotes volume and moisture. This product contains saw palmetto which helps block the DHT-hormone which can cause hair loss if overproduced in the scalp.

Monthly Cost: $19.00

5.) Conditioner

The conditioner is formulated with niacinamide to help support healthy hair growth. It can be used after shampooing your hair to provide extra moisture.

Monthly Cost: $22.00

6.) Biotin Gummies

The biotin gummies are made to promote thicker hair, stronger nails, and better skin.

Monthly Cost: $16.00

Kiierr Hair Loss Products

Kiierr offers hair loss products to men and women looking to regrow their hair effortlessly. The main powerhouse product that Kiierr sells is the FDA-cleared laser cap. This medical device is equipped with medical grade laser diodes and emits low level light therapy to the scalp tissue to stimulate blood flow and new hair growth.

Read more: What is a Laser Hair Growth Cap?

You can choose between three different laser cap options, along with supplements that are best combined with light therapy. Kiierr’s hair growth products are listed below.

1.) Kiierr FDA-Cleared Laser Caps

2.) Kiierr DHT-Blocking Shampoo

3.) Kiierr Hair Growth Conditioner

4.) Kiierr DHT-Blocking Vitamins

5.) Kiierr Biotin Gummies

Hims Hair Review vs Kiierr

Now that you have all the background information between the two companies, it is time for an overall hims hair review vs Kiierr. Both of these companies offer hair loss products for individuals suffering from overall hair loss. Hims offers products that are FDA-approved, and Kiierr’s laser caps are FDA-cleared. This helps customers feel at ease when purchasing, as they know that the products are safe and effective to use.

Both companies offer a money back guarantee if success is not seen by religiously using the products as directed. Hims money back guarantee is 90-days, where Kiierr’s is 7-months. Both companies also offer free shipping on all orders.

Although these companies are similar in some ways, there are also big differences between them. Kiierr offers products for both men and women suffering from hair loss, where hims is targeting men only. Kiierr sells hair loss products both in supplemental form as well as technological. Hims on the other hand does not offer hair growth products that work through technological treatment therapies.

Read more: Kiierr reviews

Conclusion: Hims Hair or Kiierr?

After examining each company, we recommend Kiierr to all individuals looking to regrow their hair. Kiierr will take care of all your hair loss needs, while providing top of the line technology to promote new hair growth. Kiierr’s laser caps can be paired with topical treatments, as well as the supplements provided and listed above.

Kiierr’s effortless and convenient hair loss treatment therapy can help you get your hair back! What are you waiting for? Start your hair growth journey today and get ahead of your hair loss fast!
